project_type: Monorepo: Django REST API (services/api) + Next.js 15 App Router app (apps/web) + Python simulator core (packages/simulator-core). JWT auth (SimpleJWT).
language: Backend: Python 3.13 + Django 5.1 + DRF. Frontend: TypeScript + React 19 + Next.js 15.
build_system: Django manage.py (settings split: netlab.settings.base/dev/prod). Dev DB is SQLite at services/api/db.sqlite3. Frontend: Next.js (apps/web) with npm workspaces-less package.json. Tailwind v4. Path alias @/* -> ./src/*.
test_framework: Backend: pytest + pytest-django (pytest.ini sets DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=netlab.settings.dev). Frontend: no unit test runner; the gate is `npm run build` (type-check + production build).
build_command: Backend check: `python manage.py check --settings=netlab.settings.dev` (run from services/api). Frontend: `npm run build` (run from apps/web).
test_command: Backend labs: `cd services/api && python -m pytest apps/labs/tests/ -q`. Simulator regression: `cd packages/simulator-core && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:django`. Frontend: `cd apps/web && npm run build`.
verification_instructions: 1. cd services/api && python manage.py makemigrations labs --settings=netlab.settings.dev (creates apps/labs/migrations/0001_initial.py). 2. python manage.py migrate --settings=netlab.settings.dev. 3. python manage.py check --settings=netlab.settings.dev. 4. python -m pytest apps/labs/tests/ -q (new CRUD tests + 15 existing adapter tests). 5. cd packages/simulator-core && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:django (438 tests, must not regress). 6. cd apps/web && npm run build. Use the project Python venv at services/venv (python resolves to it in the configured shell).
snapshot_or_generated_files: services/api/apps/labs/migrations/0001_initial.py is generated by makemigrations and MUST be committed. apps/web/.next/ is build output — do NOT commit (gitignored).
environment_constraints: Branch is main; work directly (no feature branch, no worktree). Do NOT push — the workflow push step handles git push. Never restart a dev server. REST_FRAMEWORK has global DEFAULT_PERMISSION_CLASSES=[IsAuthenticated] and a custom EXCEPTION_HANDLER (netlab.api.exception_handler.custom_exception_handler) that wraps all DRF errors into {error:{code,message,detail?}} — the same shape apps/web/src/lib/api.ts apiFetch throws. Pagination is ON globally (PageNumberPagination, PAGE_SIZE=20); the lab list view MUST set pagination_class=None to return a plain array. APPEND_SLASH=False; the next.config.ts rewrite proxies /api/* to the backend with and without trailing slash.
contribution_requirements: Pin deps / use lockfiles (no new deps needed here). Keep business logic out of oversized views/serializers/React components. Enforce all API authorization server-side (filter queryset by request.user). Write automated tests for domain logic, permissions, and behaviour (item FEAT-001 step 5). Do NOT break existing simulation endpoints or the static curated lab catalog. Do NOT use framer-motion. Keep the light theme (white cards, #d0d7de borders, #0969da accents).
key_patterns: DRF views: labs simulation views use APIView with permission_classes=[IsAuthenticated] and return {error:{code,message}} on failure; accounts uses generics.CreateAPIView. For Lab CRUD use DRF generics (ListCreateAPIView + RetrieveUpdateDestroyAPIView) with get_queryset filtering by owner — the custom exception handler keeps the error envelope consistent. Serializers: ModelSerializer; owner_name via source='owner.full_name' (User has a full_name @property). Migrations: FK to User uses settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL (see accounts/migrations/0001_initial). Frontend API client: apiFetch<T>(path,{method,body}) from apps/web/src/lib/api.ts, same pattern as simulation-api.ts. Modals: NodeConfigPopup.tsx (overlay + centered 320px card + Esc/Enter). UI components: apps/web/src/components/ui/{Card,Button,Badge}. Client vs server: pages exporting metadata must stay server components; move API-driven UI into a child 'use client' component. Workspace canvas state: useNodesState/useEdgesState (DeviceNode/Edge); sessionStorage key netlab_canvas_v4 stores {nodes, edges}; convertFlowToTopology is one-way and lossy on positions (no reverse) — so persist the raw {nodes, edges} canvas, not the simulator document.
directory_structure: services/api/apps/labs/ — Django app: models.py (placeholder), serializers.py (topology/ping serializers), views.py (simulation APIViews), urls.py (simulation routes), services/simulation_adapter.py, tests/test_simulation_adapter_catalog.py, migrations/__init__.py. services/api/apps/accounts/ — custom User (UUID pk, email login, full_name property, role/status) + UserProfile. services/api/netlab/ — project: settings/{base,dev,prod}.py, api/{urls.py,exception_handler.py}. apps/web/src/ — Next.js app: lib/ (api.ts, simulation-api.ts, convertFlowToTopology.ts, deviceTypes.ts), components/labs/workspace/ (WorkspaceToolbar, NodeConfigPopup, DevicePalette, NodeSidePanel, BottomPanel, FlowNodes, FlowEdge), components/ui/ (Card, Button, Badge), app/(dashboard)/{labs,labs/workspace,dashboard}. apps/web/src/lib/lab-api.ts is the new client. packages/simulator-core/ — pure-Python sim (438 tests; do not touch).
